user_story: System | Update displayed notification when selecting plant W2C1 - 6000 (Hajj 1448 -2027)

results.test_name: Notice opens when the W2C1 storage location 6000 destination is chosen
results.outcome_check: Before the destination was chosen the page showed "Select a destination to display the line items." and no Arabic notice title; after it the ship-to field read "MOH - Al Hajj", the line items loaded and the notice panel appeared with the title "تنبيه" and a close control.

results.test_name: Notice content matches the approved text, both sites and the closing lines
results.outcome_check: Title, intro sentence word for word including the closing colon, the three column headers, exactly two site rows counted in the table body, both map links exactly as recorded, and the closing lines in order with nothing after them.

results.test_name: Notice reads right to left with colon, brackets, Hijri year and links in place
results.error_message: Step 5 asks for the year digits to sit left of "هـ"; measured, "1448" is at x 623-658 and "هـ" at x 604-618, so the digits are to the right.
results.root_cause: The application renders the Hijri year correctly for right-to-left text; the step's wording states the opposite convention from step 4's own.
results.outcome_check: Steps 2, 3, 4, 6 and 7 hold: title and intro run right to left, the table is right-aligned with التصنيف rightmost and الموقع leftmost, the colon falls after "في المواقع ادناه", the opening bracket sits right of the closing one, and both links read left to right unbroken. Step 5 does not hold as written.

results.test_name: Both map links open their delivery sites in a new tab
results.outcome_check: The first link opened a second tab on Google Maps at the Nupco / Maersk warehouse in Jeddah; closing it left the page and destination unchanged. The second opened a tab titled 21 deg 26'54.2"N 39 deg 34'05.9"E, the recorded Hadda position. Neither showed an error page.

results.test_name: Notice closes, reopens on the next choice and after a reload, never blocks
results.outcome_check: Attempt 1 ran on purchase order 4300000831, whose second destination has disappeared, so precondition 3 did not hold. Re-executed on 4300000838: all seven steps hold, including switching to E3C1 / 2000 with no notice, back to W2C1 / 6000 with the notice returning within about 2.5 seconds, and the notice shown again after a full reload.

results.test_name: No notice for plant W2C1 with a storage location other than 6000
results.outcome_check: Purchase order 4300000834, destination W2C1 / 1000 "MOH Stock": the address confirms plant W2C1 and storage location 1000, the line items opened, and the page holds no notice panel and no "تنبيه".

results.test_name: No notice for a destination on another plant
results.outcome_check: Purchase order 4300000834, destination 1100 / 120215: line items opened, no notice panel and no "تنبيه"; the ASN creation page reached from it also showed none. Both request controls were offered for this plant 1100 destination.

results.test_name: Notice shown on the ASN request creation details page
results.outcome_check: The toolbar offered "Request ASN" only; the ASN creation page opened titled "ASN | Create" with "Shipped to Location" reading "MOH - Al Hajj" and the same notice content as on PO details. The notice is ordinary page content that scrolls away, so it never covers the form fields.

results.test_name: No notice on the ASN details page after the ASN is submitted
results.outcome_check: "Create" produced no short-lived GTIN message and the window "Your Request Has Been Sent" named ASN 5060-261104-19824. Its details page opened with "Shipped to Location" reading "MOH - Al Hajj" and carries no Hajj notice and no "تنبيه"; its only banner reads "ASN is not released to warehouse".

results.test_name: Exported ASN PDF carries the notice with its table and both map links
results.error_message: The browser session ended while the Create button was being pressed; the VPN had dropped.
results.root_cause: Environment — the staging host stopped resolving mid-run.
results.outcome_check: Steps 1 to 5 held. Attempt 1 ended when the calendar micro-frontend timed out loading and the page went blank; attempt 2 reached the filled form and was lost at step 6. Verified afterwards that no ASN with invoice QA5B-234822-1104 exists, so nothing was created. Not re-run this phase.

results.test_name: Re-exporting the PDF of a pre-release ASN shows the Hajj 1448 notice
results.outcome_check: The ASN list filtered to plant W2C1 / storage location 6000 showed 5060-260630-8452 created 30-06-2026, well before the release. Its details page opened and "Export PDF" downloaded request_5060-260630-8452.pdf, 79,742 bytes, saved beside this test case's evidence. Step 4 needs a person to read the PDF.

results.test_name: No Hajj 1447 content, including the Tamer Logistics site, anywhere
results.outcome_check: The notice on PO details and again on the ASN creation page carries the year 1448 and never 1447, holds exactly two site rows, and contains no "Tamer Logistics" and no "مستودعات نوبكو (حي الخمرة)".

results.test_name: Notice does not open on the NUPCO PO list before a destination is chosen
results.outcome_check: With purchase order 4300000831 brought on screen through the PO Number filter, the NUPCO PO list holds no notice panel and no "تنبيه". This settles the document's open question Q-1: the notice does not appear on the list.

results.test_name: Notice stays in Arabic when the portal is switched to another language
results.error_message: Step 2 cannot be performed: the supplier portal has no language control.
results.root_cause: The test case assumes a control this portal does not have, which the document's own open question Q-3 suspected.
results.outcome_check: Step 1 holds, the notice is shown in Arabic. No language control exists in the header, the account menu (Supplier Profile, Profile, Change Password, Logout), the application grid or the footer, and no element carries a language class, id, aria-label or test id. Steps 3 to 6 were not issued.

skips.reason: assertion_failure — the application renders the Hijri year correctly for right-to-left text; step 5's wording asks for the opposite. See Q-1
interrupted: session lost at step 6 — the VPN dropped as the request was submitted; not re-run this phase
assertion_failure — the supplier portal has no language control, so step 2 cannot be performed. See Q-2

deviations: Purchase order 4300000831 no longer offers the second destination 1100 / 120364 recorded in TEST-DATA; TC-HAJJ-05 was run on purchase order 4300000838 instead — route to skill 3 --revision.
[D3] purchase order 4300000831, destination 1100 / 120364 no longer exists; TC-HAJJ-07 used purchase order 4300000834, destination 1100 / 120215 — route to skill 3 --revision.
[D7] is recorded as UNKNOWN in TEST-DATA but exists on Staging: ASN 5060-260630-8452 (30-06-2026) and three others from April and May 2026 — route to skill 3 --revision.

TC-HAJJ-08's Expected Result calls the notice a fixed box while its own step 6 asserts it is page content; the application shows page content, so the Expected Result's wording should follow step 6 — route to skill 3 --revision.
TC-HAJJ-07 step 6 expects only one request control for a plant 1100 destination; both "Request ASN" and "Request Direct Delivery ASN" were offered — route to skill 3 --revision.
TC-HAJJ-14 precondition 3 expects [D1] on the first page of the NUPCO PO list; it is not, so the PO Number filter was used — route to skill 3 --revision.
TC-HAJJ-04 was "draft — not app-validated"; this run opened both map sites and it passed.
TC-HAJJ-15 was "draft — not app-validated (no portal language control found)"; this run confirms no such control exists anywhere in the supplier portal.
Transient loading indicators cannot be sampled between two command-line calls; the loaded state each one precedes was observed instead — route to skill 3 --revision.
left in Staging: ASN 5060-261104-19824 — created by TC-HAJJ-10; ASN cancelling is switched off, so it cannot be removed through the application.
The run was interrupted for about five hours (07:40 to 12:59 UTC) while the VPN was down, which is included in the phase duration.
